title: Initial hybrid equals the left family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a set, and let $Z_{L,i},Z_{R,i}:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be two families indexed by $0\le i<n$. For the hybrid family that uses $Z_{R,i}$ when $i<r$ and $Z_{L,i}$ otherwise, its value at $r=0$ is $Z_{L,i}$ for every coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $Z$ is a real-valued family indexed by the two copies of the $n$ coordinates
replaced: Let $Z_{L,i},Z_{R,i}\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be two families indexed by $0\le i<n$, and define $H^{(r)}_i=Z_{R,i}$ if $i<r$ and $Z_{L,i}$ otherwise. Then $H^{(0)}_i=Z_{L,i}$ for every $i$.
